title: Extension of maximal stalk ideals at rational points
statement: Let $k\subseteq K$ be an extension of fields [def-pc-field-extension], let $s:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ be a scheme over $k$ [def-pc-scheme], and let $x:\operatorname{Spec}k\to X$ be a $k$-rational point, that is, $s\circ x=\mathrm{id}$ [def-pc-rational-point]. Put $X_K=X\times_k K$ and let $p:X_K\to X$ be the projection [def-pc-base-change]. For any $y\in X_K$ with $p(y)=x(*)$, the ideal generated in $\mathcal O_{X_K,y}$ by the image of the maximal ideal of $\mathcal O_{X,p(y)}$ under $p^\sharp_y$ is the maximal ideal of $\mathcal O_{X_K,y}$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime, def-weil-pbc-module-stalk].

proof.text: Let x' be the induced K-rational point. The fibre over the k-rational point x is Spec K, so y=x'. The square consisting of x, x', Spec K to Spec k and p is cartesian by pullback pasting. Both rational-point maps are closed immersions. Their defining ideal sheaves therefore satisfy I'=I.comap(p). The Lean proof uses Scheme.Hom.baseChangeFieldPoint_eq_of_fst_eq and IsPullback.of_bot, then IdealSheafData.ker_fst_of_isClosedImmersion.

proof.text: Choose affine opens U around p(y) and V around y contained in p^{-1}(U). By [lem-pc-ideal-sheaf-comap-affine-extension], I'(V) is the ideal generated by the image of I(U) along p.appLE. For a closed immersion, Scheme.Hom.ker_stalkMap in WeilConjectures.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Morphisms.ClosedImmersion identifies its stalk kernel with the extension of its affine defining ideal [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf]. This is an already proved upstream theorem, so the proof does not invoke a separate localization-of-quotients node.

proof.text: The stalk at the unique point of Spec of a field is the field, by stalkClosedPointIso. For either rational-point map its stalk map is local, so the inverse image of the zero maximal ideal is the maximal ideal of the source stalk. Consequently the two stalk kernels in step 2 are the respective maximal ideals.

proof.text: Apply Ideal.map_map to the affine ideal I(U) along the two composites to the target stalk. The composites agree because the projection commutes with germ maps (Scheme.Hom.germ_stalkMap), and restriction from p^{-1}(U) to V commutes with germs (TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res). Replacing the extended affine ideals by the stalk kernels of step 2 and maximal ideals of step 3 proves the required equality.

theorem Scheme.rational_point_base_change_maximalIdeal
    (k K : Type u) [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (s : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (x : s.fieldPoints k)
    (y : (pullback s (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))) : Scheme.{u}))
    (hy : pullback.fst s (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))) y =
      x.1.base default) :
    Ideal.map
      ((pullback.fst s (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))).stalkMap y).hom
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk
        (pullback.fst s (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))) y))) =
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal
        ((pullback s (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))).presheaf.stalk y)
